title: Two more reasoning models
summary:
Two reasoning models joined the lineup while video playback, structured output, and image-request handling got some attention.

Added Fireworks AI’s GLM-4.7 as `glm` and MiniMax-M2.1 as `minimax`. Both support reasoning and tools, with context windows of roughly 200,000 tokens.

Play now renders results from video-output models such as Veo 3.1 in a video player instead of an image element. Model descriptions appear on hover; Enter also distinguishes audio input from output and labels Seedance’s pricing figures in videos rather than seconds.

Gemini structured-output requests no longer collide with tool settings. Random seeds now stay within Vertex AI’s supported range, and different `gptimage` seeds get distinct cache entries—though Azure GPT Image still does not generate reproducibly from a seed.

highlights.title: GLM-4.7 joins the lineup
highlights.text: Use `glm` for text generation with reasoning and tool support, plus a 198,000-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=glm).

highlights.title: MiniMax-M2.1 joins the lineup
highlights.text: Use `minimax` for text generation with reasoning and tool support, plus a 200,000-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax).
